summary: Yu Suzuki and Sega AM2's 1988 sprite-scaling kart racer, known for roller-coaster tracks and a tilting hydraulic arcade cabinet.

entries.title: Power Drift

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation or original hardware for primary; official re-releases are convenient access routes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Arcade Y Board output with modern scaling; original cabinet motion requires hardware

primary.version: Original Sega Y Board arcade release
primary.why: Power Drift was designed for Sega Y Board arcade hardware with dynamic sprite scaling and a sit-down hydraulic cabinet that tilted and shook during races. Home computer and console releases are ports or compilation access routes and do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; the Sega Saturn Sega Ages, Dreamcast Yu Suzuki Game Works, and Nintendo 3DS Sega 3D Reprint Archives releases are official access routes if owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mega Drive, 32X, and Sega CD versions were planned but not released.
